text:
zoe_support: Customer acme-co (acct: acct_01GXYZ) reports their free-trial grant is blocked because the card-on-file 3DS flow never completes. After redirect the PaymentIntent ends up `requires_payment_method` and trial is not auto-granted. Ticket: https://support/internal/INC-1234

payments-bot: webhook snapshot (delivered to our processor): {"id":"pi_1Jabc", "status":"requires_action", "last_payment_error":{"message":"3DS auth incomplete","code":"authentication_required"}}

ian_payments: Can you paste the full webhook body + the payment_method id and the raw payment_intent confirm logs? Also which card brand? If issuer triggers 3DS we should see a `next_action` object with a URL. Sometimes merchant front-end doesn't finish the redirect/confirm and cancels from their side.

zoe_support: Got a tiny snippet from the customer (they said they saw "Authentication successful" in the redirect). HAR inbound, but here's our webhook consumer log around the event:

```
POST /webhooks/payments 200
{"id":"pi_1Jabc","status":"requires_payment_method","last_payment_error":{"message":"3DS auth incomplete","code":"authentication_required"}}
```

deepa_engineering: Quick hypothesis: our webhook parser in v2.3.1 ignores the alias `payment_intent_id` when merchants wrap events. If the merchant client returns the confirmation under a nonstandard field (some SDKs do this) our processor treats `requires_action` as transient and times out the intent. We also have a 30s processing timeout that might be too aggressive for slow issuer redirects.

mike_ops: Confirmed: v2.3.1 was deployed 2025-05-14T03:12:00Z to prod. You can grep the webhook processor logs: `sudo grep pi_1Jabc /var/log/webhook-processor/*.log | tail -n 50` — look for events around 2025-05-14T03:14:xxZ.

zoe_support: Customer insists they completed the 3DS flow and saw "Authentication successful" but the merchant page hung on "Returning to merchant". HAR is attached to INC-1234. They need access now.

ian_payments: For immediate relief we can manually grant the free trial in the admin console. Policy: log manual grants in the ticket and add a tag for engineering follow-up. If you confirm account ID and desired period I'll apply it.

zoe_support: Please grant 14-day trial to acct_01GXYZ. Note in the ticket: "Manual grant due to 3DS webhook mismatch; customer reported successful auth but intent ended as requires_payment_method."

ian_payments: Done — 14-day trial granted and ticket updated. Admin note: "manual grant: 3DS webhook mismatch; engineering to investigate." Also added meta `payment_3ds_repro: true`.

deepa_engineering: I'll open a patch (v2.3.2) to: (1) accept `payment_intent_id` alias fields during event parsing, (2) increase pending window for `requires_action` events to 10 minutes before marking failed, and (3) add stricter logging for `next_action` payloads. Repro steps for QA: run local Cardinal simulation and POST our simulated `payment_intent.requires_action` event to the webhook consumer:

```
# repro (local)
make test-3ds
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/webhooks -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @simulated_event.json
# expect: processor logs "pi_1Jabc requires_action -> pending" and awaits subsequent succeeded/failed event
```

zoe_support: Thanks — letting customer know trial is active and we're investigating the root cause. Marking as escalated. :thumbsup:

mike_ops: Also adding a runbook note: if manual grant is issued, add the tag `manual_trial_grant` and set a follow-up task for eng within 72h.

deepa_engineering: Will follow up in the PR with a link to the fix and tests. I'll reference INC-1234.

zoe_support: Closing loop here for now. HAR + webhook payloads attached to ticket.
